cycle.description: Round-robin router: first arg sets number of outlets (messages cycle through outlets 0..N-1). Default: 2 outlets.

_audit.finding: DQ-02 / FN-01: lifted from per-domain inline io_rule (cycle had variable_io=true but no overrides.json rule; compute_io_counts was mis-counting).

combine.description: Number of arguments determines number of inlets. Default: 2 inlets.

_audit.finding: DQ-02 / FN-01: lifted from per-domain inline io_rule (combine had variable_io=true but no overrides.json rule).

router.description: Variable routing matrix: first arg = inlets, second arg = outlets. Default: 2x2.

_audit.finding: DQ-02 / FN-01: lifted from per-domain inline io_rule (router had variable_io=true but no overrides.json rule; compute_io_counts was returning wrong default counts).

routepass.description: Outlets = arg count + 1 (extra outlet passes unmatched through). Default: 2 outlets (matches routepass DB entry).

_audit.finding: FN-01 / DQ-02: lifted from extract_objects.py VARIABLE_IO_RULES constant with formula normalized from 'arg_count_plus_1' to 'arg_count+1'. 260421-bti aligned default_outlets (3 → 2) with the routepass per-domain DB entry; behaviorally identical because arg_count+1 formula never falls through to default_outlets. Aliases 't' and 'sel' intentionally NOT lifted because alias resolution runs before rule lookup in compute_io_counts.

mc.combine~.description: mc.combine~ number-of-inlets: first arg sets inlet count. Default 2 inlets. Output is a single multichannel signal that concatenates all channels from inputs.

_audit.finding: Unlike core 'combine' (arg_count over list args), mc.combine~ takes one optional int for inlet count. Default 2 per docs.

mc.deinterleave~.description: mc.deinterleave~ outputs: first arg sets outlet count. Default 2 outlets.

_audit.finding: Single int 'outputs' arg. Default 2 inferred from DB entry (no refpage default stated).

mc.fffb~.description: mc.fffb~ number-of-filters: first arg sets signal outlet count (one per filter). When instantiated as 'mcs.fffb~' this behavior collapses into a single MC outlet — the mcs variant is a different object. Default 4 outlets (matches DB entry).

_audit.finding: Refpage: 'mcs.fffb~ has a single multichannel output; otherwise it has a separate outlet for each filter.' This rule is for mc.fffb~ (separate outlets); mcs variants are separate objects in the DB if they exist.

mc.gate~.description: mc.gate~ number-of-outlets: first arg sets outlet count. Default 1 outlet. Mirrors core 'gate' rule (inlet_count:fixed:2 is the signal-domain pattern from gate — control route inlet + signal inlet).

_audit.finding: Same arg semantics as MSP gate~ / core gate. Note: DB entry shows 2 inlets (signal+route), which matches fixed:2.

mc.interleave~.description: mc.interleave~ inputs: first arg sets inlet count. Default 2 inlets.

_audit.finding: Single int 'inputs' arg; default 2 per refpage.

mc.matrix~.description: mc.matrix~ inlets outlets: first arg = signal inlets, second = signal outlets. Default 2x2. Note: rule targets signal I/O; an additional non-signal dump outlet (list) is always present — see DQ-07 corner case #3.

_audit.finding: Same semantics as matrix~ (rule already in overrides.json). Rule intentionally excludes the always-present 3rd dump outlet (list Inlets/Outlets/Gains). Downstream callers that need full outlet shape should read the DB outlets array directly.

mc.pack~.description: mc.pack~ size: argument sets both inlet count and output channel count. Default 2 inlets. Output is a single multichannel signal outlet.

_audit.finding: Argument-driven inlet count. Distinct from core 'pack' (arg_count over typespec list); mc.pack~ takes a single int 'size'.

mc.selector~.description: mc.selector~ number-of-inputs: first arg + 1 sets inlet count (N inputs plus a selector inlet at left). Default 2 inlets.

_audit.finding: Identical semantics to selector~ (rule already in overrides.json).

mc.separate~.description: mc.separate~ channels-per-outlet: each argument creates one outlet whose MC signal has the specified channel count. Default 2 outlets.

_audit.finding: Argument list drives outlet count (mirrors core 'pack' arg_count pattern). Refpage: 'Each argument creates an outlet whose output multichannel signal will contain the number of channels specified by that argument.'

mc.unpack~.description: mc.unpack~ size: argument sets single-channel outlet count. Default 2 outlets. Input is a single multichannel signal inlet.

_audit.finding: Argument-driven outlet count. Distinct from core 'unpack' (arg_count over typespec list); mc.unpack~ takes a single int 'size'.
